correctness.rationale: Coordinate evaluations yield an absolutely summable atomic sequence; finite-support modifications prove ℓ1-additive atomic/singular dual splitting in both scalar fields. The bidual is the coordinate sequence map. Unit near-attainment implies singular mass <δ; conversely, the convex hull of singular-shifted unimodular coordinate functionals realizes every atomic ball at singular mass <δ, and approximation settles equality. Singular truncation attains the distance lower bound. Hahn–Banach on ℓ∞/c0 constructs a norm-one singular functional to exclude every 0<r≤1. These are norm arguments valid over the full infinite domains, not finite tests.
